purpose: Positive fixture of a Session that the v0.14.5 CLI wrote for a --comparisons_table BLAST table: request schema 9 stores the table's rows as precomputedProteinComparison (canonical TSV with the 12 BLAST columns only), the kind a LOSATP protein pair is also stored as. A reader keeps it a nucleotide table: its replay says "Comparison of record #1 BGC0000708 and record #2 BGC0000709: kept 1 of 1 row.", and a re-save stores it as nucleotideBlast (OV-3512).
history: release tag v0.14.5 (first-parent main 033a3aa89); every release from v0.14.0 wrote this form (gbdraw/api/record_planning.py builds the comparisons-table LinearComparison without its file's text, and _encode_comparisons stores such a comparison as precomputedProteinComparison)
route: in a directory holding copies of tests/test_inputs/BGC0000708.gbk and BGC0000709.gbk, pair.tsv (one row: BGC0000708 BGC0000709 90 100 0 0 1 100 1 100 1e-20 200) and comparisons.tsv (header blast query subject; row pair.tsv #1 #2): gbdraw linear --gbk BGC0000708.gbk BGC0000709.gbk --comparisons_table comparisons.tsv -o v0145-table -f svg --session_output v0145-table.gbdraw-session.json, with gbdraw from that tag (git archive v0.14.5 gbdraw); the written file was compressed with gzip -n -9
values: renderRequest.comparisons[0]: kind precomputedProteinComparison, resourceId comparison-explicit-1, queryRecordIndex 0, subjectRecordIndex 1; the v0.14.5 render logged "Comparison table pair.tsv (record #1 BGC0000708 and record #2 BGC0000709): kept 1 of 1 row."
